item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.106

  • Raises Powerhouse thread defaults and worker ceilings for much more aggressive CPU/GPU/silicon utilization.
  • Runs all Companion Realtime Voice HF sidecar profiles in repeated concurrent warm bursts instead of staged primary/fallback warmup.
  • Increases TTS, route, and network warm probes so the Mac converges faster toward a hot realtime appliance state.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.105

  • Makes selected-runtime prewarming and Powerhouse warm passes advisory, never blockers for starting a VoiceClaw route.
  • Keeps aggressive background warming while preserving route start responsiveness.
  • Clarifies Companion readiness wording so dependency installation is separate from warmup state.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.104

  • Removes Powerhouse resource pressure as a readiness blocker; resource posture is now diagnostics-only.
  • Runs Powerhouse warmup aggressively without selected-only fallback deferral or worker throttling.
  • Honors Cerebras as the selected Companion Realtime Voice LLM when native iPhone STT/TTS are selected.
  • Prevents Cerebras-selected turns from silently falling back to the local/Qwen planner when the Cerebras planner response is incomplete.
  • Raises runtime request body ceilings for large audio/config payloads.
